summary: A delivery-summary failure on a subscription storefront must not be labeled one-off/unica; only known storefronts resolve, so checkout URLs always have a subdomain; catalog drift also reports baked stores the live catalog dropped.
reason: checkout preview treated every result that was not (subscription and delivery-ok) as a one-off store, so a transient /delivery/summary error on programada, fresh, or pet overwrote the note with unica text. ResolveStore accepted unknown numeric ids as a store with an empty subdomain, and checkout preview built https://.shopper.com.br/shop/checkout. Drift only walked live rows, so a storefront removed from GET /features/stores stayed selectable with no warning. An unparseable or empty catalog still reports nothing.
validated_outcome: TestSubscriptionDeliveryFailureDoesNotRelabelAsOneOff keeps the auth note and skips the charge calendar when delivery summary fails for programada/fresh/pet. TestNonSubscriptionCheckoutKeepsModeLabel still marks unica one-off and now ultra-fast. TestUnknownNumericStoreIDIsRejected and TestCheckoutURLNeverHasEmptySubdomain reject store id 99 and refuse an empty host label. TestStoreCatalogDriftDetectsClusterMismatch reports a baked storefront missing from a non-empty live catalog, and still returns nil for unparseable and empty bodies.
